in_marathi.name: Drashti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drashti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Drashti represents the power of perception and insight. It is believed that a person with the name Drashti possesses a keen sense of understanding and the ability to see things beyond the physical realm.
